statement.name: GetDMInfo
statement.sql:
select TRI.*, DM.FileName, DM.FileSize, DM.FileDescription, DM.UploadedDateTime, P.FirstName + ' ' + P.LastName as UploadedBy
into #TempDMInfo
from #TempResourceInfo TRI join DM_Attachment DM on DM.AttachmentId = TRI.AttachmentId and DM.AttachmentInstance = TRI.AttachmentInstance join People P on P.UserId = DM.CreatorId
order by ; drop table #TempResourceInfo

insert into @T_Attachments( AttachmentId, AttachmentInstance, FilePath) select DM.AttachmentId, DM.AttachmentInstance, DM.FileLocation + case right(DM.FileLocation,1) when '\' then '' else '\' end + DM.PhysicalFileName from DM_Attachment DM join WT on WT. = DM.AttachmentId
and WT. = DM.AttachmentInstance

and WT. = DM.AttachmentInstance
and WT. =

statement.name: getAttachmentDetailByAttachmentId
statement.sql: select DM.CreatorId as DocumentCreatorId, DM.AttachmentId, DM.AttachmentInstance, DM.FileLocation, DM.FileName, DM.FileSize, DM.FileExtension, DM.FileDescription, DM.PhysicalFileName, DM.UploadedDateTime as CreatedDate, IsNull( '' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),DM.UploadedDateTime,101) +'','-' ) as CreatedDateString, isnull(P.FirstName, '') + case when P.FirstName is null or P.LastName is null then '' else ' ' end + isnull(P.LastName, '') as CreatedBy from DM_Attachment DM join People P on P.UserId = DM.CreatorId order by DM.AttachmentInstance desc

statement.name: getAttachmentDetails
statement.sql: select DM.CreatorId as DocumentCreatorId, DM.AttachmentId, DM.AttachmentInstance, DM.FileLocation, DM.FileName, DM.FileSize, DM.FileExtension, DM.FileDescription, DM.PhysicalFileName, DM.UploadedDateTime as CreatedDate, IsNull( '' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),DM.UploadedDateTime,101) +'','-' ) as CreatedDateString, isnull(P.FirstName, '') + case when P.FirstName is null or P.LastName is null then '' else ' ' end + isnull(P.LastName, '') as CreatedBy ,LAP.LookupCode as PurposeCode ,LAP.LongDisplayValue as PurposeDescription , AS ResourceValue , AS ResourceInstance , from DM_Attachment DM join ( select DM.AttachmentId, max(DM.AttachmentInstance) as AttachmentInstance from DM_Attachment DM join WT on WT. = DM.AttachmentId and WT. = DM.AttachmentInstance group by DM.AttachmentId ) as MaxInst on MaxInst.AttachmentId = DM.AttachmentId and MaxInst.AttachmentInstance = DM.AttachmentInstance join WT on WT. = DM.AttachmentId and WT. = DM.AttachmentInstance join LookupAttachmentPurpose LAP on LAP.LookupCode = WT. join People P on P.UserId = DM.CreatorId
